notes: The volume, brightness and microphone bars are actually thin now. They were set to 2px and reported 2px, but the code that paints the fill used the CSS background shorthand, which silently reset the rule keeping the paint inside that 2px…

Bluetooth and Wi-Fi now sit side by side. They were stacked because the card inherited a vertical direction, and the rule that was supposed to stop them stacking only prevents a second line - it says nothing about which way the first line…

Those two are now icon-only. Side by side leaves 61px each, and the word Bluetooth does not fit in that - it was rendering cut off with an ellipsis, which reads as a bug rather than a choice. The names are still there for tooltips and…
